digo: matsere (northern Digo) / pemba, mapemba (southern Digo); cob tsere
digo_source: Mgombato ('matsere corn, maize'; 'pemba maize'; 'tsere maize cob'); Pakia (Matsere N, Mapemba S)

teaser.en: North of the Digo country maize is *matsere*; in the south it is *pemba*, and both are ground into flour for *ugali*.
teaser.sw: Kaskazini mwa nchi ya Wadigo mahindi ni *matsere*; kusini ni *pemba*, na yote mawili husagwa kuwa unga wa *ugali*.
teaser.dg: Adigo a kazikazini nkuiha mahindi *matsere*; a kusini nkugaiha *pemba*, na gosi nkusagbwa unga wa kujitira *sima*.

summary.en: *Matsere* is maize, the main rain-fed cereal of Digo farms. It is ground into flour for *ugali*, roasted on the cob and baked with bananas into *mabumbunda*.
summary.sw: *Matsere* ni mahindi, nafaka kuu inayotegemea mvua katika mashamba ya Wadigo. Husagwa kuwa unga wa *ugali*, gunzi huchomwa motoni na huokwa pamoja na ndizi kuwa *mabumbunda*.
summary.dg: *Matsere* ni nafaka kulu ya mvula kpwenye minda ya Adigo. Nkusagbwa unga wa sima, nkuochwa gachikala bado kpwenye tsere, na nkutsanganywa na mazu kuhenda *mabumbunda*.

about.en:
*Matsere* is a tall cereal grass with broad, strap-shaped leaves and a tassel of male flowers at the top of the stem. The cobs (*tsere*) form lower down, wrapped in husks, each sending out a tuft of silk.

Digo farmers grow both local cultivars and modern hybrids. The local kinds are named by grain colour: *maricheni* (yellow), *chitweka* (black), *mwatsaka* (red), *tsere ra matungo* (mixed) and *mjundo* (striped). Hybrids such as *kosti* and *katumani* are also grown.
about.sw:
*Matsere* ni nyasi ndefu ya nafaka yenye majani mapana yenye umbo la utepe na shada la maua ya kiume juu ya shina. Magunzi (*tsere*) hutokea chini zaidi, yakiwa yamefunikwa na makoba, na kila moja hutoa kishungi cha nywele.

Wakulima Wadigo hupanda aina za kienyeji na mbegu chotara za kisasa. Aina za kienyeji hupewa majina kulingana na rangi ya punje: *maricheni* (manjano), *chitweka* (nyeusi), *mwatsaka* (nyekundu), *tsere ra matungo* (mchanganyiko) na *mjundo* (yenye michirizi). Mbegu chotara kama *kosti* na *katumani* pia hupandwa.
about.dg:
*Matsere* ni nafaka nyire ya jamii ya nyasi, yenye makodza mapana na mare, na *punga* ya maruwa ga chilume dzulu ya muhi. Matsere ganamera photsi zaidi: chila *tsere* rinafwinikpwa ni magada, na rinalavya njiyo.

Akurima a Adigo anaphanda aina za chienyeji na aina za chisasa. Aina za chienyeji nkuihwa kpwa rangi ya tembe: *maricheni* (rangi ya manjano), *chitweka* (rangi nyiru), *mwatsaka* (rangi ya kundu), *tsere ra matungo* (rangi za kutsanganyika) na *mjundo* (mistari-mistari). Aina za chisasa dza *kosti* na *katumani* piya nkuphandwa.

where.en: Maize is the main rain-fed cereal of Kwale farms, planted with the rains and often intercropped with cassava and cowpeas. After harvest the grain is stored in the granary, the *chitsaga*.
where.sw: Mahindi ndiyo nafaka kuu inayotegemea mvua katika mashamba ya Kwale, yakipandwa mvua zinapoanza na mara nyingi yakichanganywa na muhogo na kunde. Baada ya mavuno nafaka huhifadhiwa ghalani, *chitsaga*.
where.dg: *Matsere* ni nafaka kulu ya mvula kpwenye minda ya Kwale. Nkuphandwa mvula zichiandza, na mara nyinji nkuphandwa phamwenga na manga na kunde. Bada ya mavuno, tembe nkuikpwa kpwenye ghala, *chitsaga*.

uses.en:
The dried grain is ground into flour (*sima* or *dona*) for *ugali*, the stiff porridge eaten across East Africa. Fresh cobs are roasted over coals. Maize flour and bananas are combined to make *mabumbunda*, a maize-banana bread.

After harvest the stalks, *buwa*, are left in the field.
uses.sw:
Nafaka iliyokaushwa husagwa kuwa unga (*sima* au *dona*) wa *ugali*, chakula kizito kinacholiwa kote Afrika Mashariki. Magunzi mabichi huchomwa juu ya makaa. Unga wa mahindi na ndizi huchanganywa kutengeneza *mabumbunda*, mkate wa mahindi na ndizi.

Baada ya mavuno mabua, *buwa*, huachwa shambani.
uses.dg:
Tembe zikauma nkusagbwa kuhenda unga (*sima* au *dona*) wa kujitira sima (*ugali*), chakurya chigumu chinachoriwa kosi Afrika ya Mashariki. Matsere maitsi nkuochwa dzulu ya makala. Unga wa matsere na mazu nkutsanganywa kuhenda *mabumbunda*, mkahe wa matsere na mazu.

Bada ya mavuno, mihi iriyosala, *buwa*, nkurichwa mndani.

culture.en: Maize farming carries a whole body of Digo know-how, from choosing seed to storing the grain in the *chitsaga*. The red cultivar *mwatsaka* shares its name with the Digo word for chilli pepper.
culture.sw: Kilimo cha mahindi kina hazina nzima ya maarifa ya Kidigo, kuanzia kuchagua mbegu hadi kuhifadhi nafaka katika *chitsaga*. Aina nyekundu *mwatsaka* inashiriki jina na neno la Kidigo la pilipili hoho.
culture.dg: Chirimo cha matsere china marifwa manji ga Chidigo, kula kutsambula mbeyu hadi kuika tembe kpwenye *chitsaga*. Aina ya kundu, *mwatsaka*, ina dzina sawa na *mwatsaka*, pilipili kpwa Chidigo.

names.en: Digo: *matsere* in northern Digo and *pemba* or *mapemba* in southern Digo; the cob is *tsere*. Swahili: *mahindi*. English: maize or corn. Scientists call it *Zea mays*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *matsere* katika Kidigo cha kaskazini na *pemba* au *mapemba* katika Kidigo cha kusini; gunzi ni *tsere*. Kiswahili: *mahindi*. Kiingereza: *maize* au *corn*. Wanasayansi huyaita *Zea mays*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo: *matsere* kpwa Chidigo cha kazikazini, na *pemba* au *mapemba* kpwa Chidigo cha kusini; *cob* kpwa Chingereza ni *tsere*. Kpwa Chiswahili ganaihwa *mahindi*, kpwa Chingereza *maize* au *corn*. Kpwa chisayansi ganaihwa *Zea mays*.

reason.en: Sorghum, another cereal ground for porridge
reason.sw: Mtama, nafaka nyingine inayosagwa kwa ajili ya uji
reason.dg: Mhama, nafaka yanjina inayosagbwa kujitira uji

reason.sw: Nafaka nyingine ya unga wa ugali
reason.dg: Nafaka yanjina ya unga wa sima

reason.en: Cassava, grown in the same fields
reason.dg: Manga, ganaphandwa kpwenye minda iyo iyo

reason.en: Banana, mixed with maize in mabumbunda
reason.sw: Ndizi, zinazochanganywa na mahindi katika mabumbunda
reason.dg: Mgomba, mazuge ganatsanganywa na matsere kuhenda *mabumbunda*

reason.en: Chilli, which shares a name with red maize
reason.sw: Pilipili, inayoshiriki jina na mahindi mekundu
reason.dg: Mwatsaka, ambao una dzina sawa na matsere ga kundu

definition.en: The maize cob; Pakia notes the word is used for the maize plant as well. Matsere (the plural) is the usual word for maize.
definition.sw: Gunzi la mahindi; Pakia anabainisha kwamba neno hili hutumika pia kwa mmea wa mahindi. Matsere (wingi) ndilo neno la kawaida la mahindi.
definition.dg: Seemu ya matsere ambayo tembe zinamera dzuluye (*cob*); Pakia anaandika kukala neno hiri nkuhumirwa piya kpwa muhi wa matsere. Matsere (unji) ndiro neno ra kawaida kpwa mahindi.

meaning.en: From an old Bantu word for 'cleaned grain'; the change to tsere keeps it apart from mtele, cleaned rice.
meaning.sw: Kutoka neno la zamani la Kibantu lenye maana ya 'nafaka iliyosafishwa'; badiliko kuwa tsere linalitofautisha na mtele, mchele uliosafishwa.
meaning.dg: Rinalavywa kula neno ra kare ra Chibantu ra 'tembe zirizoezwa'; kugaluka kukala *tsere* kunaritafwautisha na *mtele*, mphunga urioezwa.

definition.en: The male flower at the top of the maize plant. Farmers watch it as a sign of ripeness: when it dries, the cob is ready to harvest. One respondent also called it thamra, a word other Digo did not know.
definition.sw: Ua la kiume lililo juu ya mmea wa mahindi. Wakulima hulitazama kama ishara ya kukomaa: likikauka, gunzi liko tayari kuvunwa. Mhojiwa mmoja pia aliliita thamra, neno ambalo Wadigo wengine hawakulijua.
definition.dg: Ruwa ra chilume dzulu ya muhi wa matsere. Akurima nkurilola dza alama ya kuivwa: richiuma, tsere ri tayari kuvunwa. Mutu mmwenga ariyeuzwa piya wariiha *thamra*, neno ambaro Adigo anjina kala taarimanya.

meaning.en: Probably from mphunga, rice, which has a similar flower head.
meaning.sw: Huenda kutoka mphunga, mpunga, ambao una shada la maua linalofanana.
meaning.dg: Pengine rinalavywa kula *mphunga*, ambao una maruwa ga dzulu ganayofanana na higa.

shared_with: punga: the florets of the coconut flower
punga: the flowering panicles of grasses and sugarcane

definition.en: The young female flower of maize, the cob in its early growth wrapped in its husk. Unlike the tassel, it counts as a ruwa (flower) because it bears fruit.
definition.sw: Ua changa la kike la mahindi, yaani gunzi katika ukuaji wake wa mwanzo likiwa limefunikwa na koba lake. Tofauti na shada la juu, huhesabiwa kama ruwa (ua) kwa sababu huzaa tunda.
definition.dg: Ruwa ra chichetu ra matsere richikala bado ridide: tsere rinaroandza kumera, ririrofwinikpwa ni gadare. Tafwauti na punga, rinahesabiwa kukala *ruwa* kpwa sababu rinalavya tunda.

meaning.en: Sheath: the husk covers the growing cob as a sheath covers a knife.
meaning.sw: Ala: koba hufunika gunzi linalokua kama ala inavyofunika kisu.
meaning.dg: Ala: gada rinafwinika tsere rinarokula dza chowa chinavyofwinika rumu.

definition.en: The female flower of maize, the part that becomes the cob (labelled in Pakia's Fig. 3.4).
definition.sw: Ua la kike la mahindi, sehemu inayokuwa gunzi (lililoonyeshwa katika Mchoro 3.4 wa Pakia).
definition.dg: Ruwa ra chichetu ra matsere, seemu inayokala tsere (Pakia akarionyesa kpwenye Picha 3.4).

definition.en: The female flower of maize, known only from the growth-stage phrase ganatuluza-ndamba, 'producing female flowers'.
definition.sw: Ua la kike la mahindi, linalojulikana tu kutoka msemo wa hatua ya ukuaji ganatuluza-ndamba, 'yanatoa maua ya kike'.
definition.dg: Ruwa ra chichetu ra matsere. Rinamanyikana tu kula maneno ga kugomba hatua ya kukula, *ganatuluza-ndamba*, 'ganalavya maruwa ga chichetu'.

definition.en: The silks, the long threads hanging from the tip of the cob. They appear in the sixth month (described as ganasonga, 'plaiting'); when they are lost (matsere ganakata njio) the cob is mature.
definition.sw: Nywele za gunzi, nyuzi ndefu zinazoning'inia kutoka ncha ya gunzi. Hutokea katika mwezi wa sita (hali inayoelezwa kama ganasonga, 'kusuka'); zinapopotea (matsere ganakata njio) gunzi limekomaa.
definition.dg: Nyuzi nyire zirizobwadzika kula ntsa ya tsere. Zinazuka mwezi wa sita (nkugombwa *ganasonga*, 'ganasuka'); zichimala (*matsere ganakata njio*), tsere rikaivwa.

meaning.en: Also the name of a colourful hanging costume worn by traditional dancers.
meaning.sw: Pia ni jina la vazi lenye rangi nyingi linaloning'inia linalovaliwa na wachezaji ngoma za jadi.
meaning.dg: Piya ni dzina ra nguwo ya rangi nyinji iriyobwadzika, inayovwalwa ni atu anaofwiha ngoma za chienyeji.

definition.en: The milky juice in maize grains at the milk stage; its presence shows the grain is not yet mature.
definition.sw: Majimaji kama maziwa yaliyo katika punje za mahindi katika hatua ya maziwa; kuwepo kwake huonyesha kwamba punje bado haijakomaa.
definition.dg: Madzi dza maziya ganayokala ndani ya tembe za matsere zichikala bado mbitsi; gachikalamo, ganaonyesa kukala tembe tazidzangbweivwa.

definition.en: The hard core of the maize cob. Mgombato spells it guguta (class ma): a cob with the grains removed.
definition.sw: Kiini kigumu cha gunzi la mahindi. Mgombato analiandika guguta (ngeli ya ma): gunzi lililotolewa punje.
definition.dg: Kahi ngumu ya tsere. Mgombato unaiandika *guguta* (ma-): tsere risiro na tembe.

definition.en: The stalk left standing after the maize has been harvested.
definition.sw: Bua linalobaki likiwa limesimama baada ya mahindi kuvunwa.
definition.dg: Muhi unaosala mndani bada ya matsere kuvunwa.

mgombato: tsere (ma) maize cob; mahindi. (See: matsere, pembe)
